definitions.explanation: The first snowfall of the winter season in a given area. An event that is often reported in the news and marks the arrival of winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧、{初雪|はつゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}った→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: The first snow of the season fell this morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{初雪|はつゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The first snow of the season was observed in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{初雪|はつゆき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧、12⟦{月|がつ}→月：30418_gatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧だった。
examples.english: This year's first snow came later than usual, not until December.

notes:
Part of a group of seasonal "first" words using ⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧:
- ⟦{初日|はつひ}の{出|で}→初日の出：10452_hatsuhinode⟧ (first sunrise of the new year)
- ⟦{初夢|はつゆめ}→初夢：16702_hatsuyume⟧ (first dream of the new year)
- ⟦{初霜|はつしも}→初霜：18804_hatsushimo⟧ (first frost of the season)

The first snow is announced officially by local meteorological observatories and is often treated as a seasonal news event.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初雪|はつゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧ (the first snow falls)
- {初雪|はつゆき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観測|かんそく}→観測：00183_kansoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (observe the first snow)
- {初雪|はつゆき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧ / ⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ (the first snow is early / late)
